title: Conductive hydrogel bioelectronics for chronic neuromodulation: From biomimetic design and bioactive interfaces to integrated neural platforms

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Conductive hydrogel bioelectronics for chronic neuromodulation: From biomimetic design and bioactive interfaces to integrated neural platforms》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Introduction · p0035】Population aging and the rising prevalence of neurological disorders—including Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and refractory chronic pain—are placing mounting pressure on healthcare systems [1,2]. These diseases not only lower the quality of life of patients, but also bring heavy social and economic burden. Systemic drug therapy is often difficult to accurately modulate specific central or peripheral nerve circuits in space and time, and is often accompanied by dose-related side effects. Electrical interventions such as deep brain stimulation can directly act on nerve circuits, but there is a long-term mechanical mismatch between rigid or thin-film electrodes and soft nerve tissue. Fretting, foreign body reaction, colloidal scar, signal attenuation, and even the final device failure is all caused by this. How to solve the mechanical mismatch between tissue and device is still a core problem in the field of chronic neuromodulation (see Table 6).

【Introduction · p0040】In this context, the progress of hydrogel materials science provides a feasible path for the construction of mechanically compliant tissue electronic interfaces (Fig. 1). The hydrogel has high water content and adjustable modulus, which can alleviate the mechanical mismatch problem to a certain extent. However, conductive hydrogels cannot be generally classified as a single mixed conduction category [3,4]. The hydrogel, which is dominated by ion conduction, transfers charge by the migration of hydrated ions in water rich pores; In the case of electron conduction, holes, polarons or electrons are transported by the percolation path formed by conjugated polymers, carbon materials, MXene or metal fillers; The ion electron hybrid conductor needs to have both continuous electronic pathways and mobile ion phases involved in charge transfer. The existence of water, electrolyte or electronic filler in the system alone is not enough to prove that the mixed conduction mechanism has been established. Therefore, the classification of this review will be defined according to the verified carrier and conduction path of each system, and the 1 kHz impedance and phase, electrochemical window, charge storage capacity (CSC), charge injection capacity (CIC), noise and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), cycle stability, hydration aging and other indicators will be used in the device evaluation, rather than the DC conductivity alone [[5], [6], [7], [8], [9], [10]].

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Conductive hydrogel bioelectronics for chronic neuromodulation: From biomimetic design and bioactive interfaces to integrated neural platforms》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Material-to-device metrics · p0130】In the final analysis, bulk conductivity is only a descriptive index at the material level, and it is still far from being used to predict recording or stimulation performance. At least, the following aspects should be covered in the data report of neural interface research: (I) impedance amplitude and phase angle at 1 kHz, and the geometric area, area normalization method, electrode configuration, disturbance amplitude, bias condition, medium and temperature should be noted; (II) electrochemical stability window - it shall be defined based on oxygen evolution/hydrogen evolution or irreversible reaction, and shall be clearly distinguished from the scanning range of cyclic voltammetry; (III) CSC from CV and CIC from charge balance pulse, with waveform, pulse width, voltage/current limit and polarization criteria attached; (IV) input reference noise or electrode noise (root mean square voltage and/or power spectral density), and signal-to-noise ratio - the signal-to-noise ratio needs to give a clear signal definition and bandwidth; (v) The number of electrical and mechanical cycles, amplitude, frequency, and impedance/csc/cic retained after the cycle; (VI) long term immersion data in PBS or serum at 37 °C. impedance, phase angle, conductivity, swelling, mass loss, adhesion and electrochemical indicators were measured at matching time points.

【Material-to-device metrics · p0135】Looking back at the current evidence, we can only say that there are different emphases, but they are not complete. T-ech provides 1 kHz impedance, CSC, CV scanning range, ECG SNR and short-term hydration stability, but it lacks the value of 1 kHz phase angle and cic [20]. TN-H gives 1 kHz impedance, phase angle (in graphical form), CV range, csc/cic and retention rate under strain, but the recorded noise/signal-to-noise ratio and weeks of immersion data have not been reported [23]. ICAA took out 1 kHz impedance CIC, 100000 cycles stability and 4-week PBS aging data, but lack of phase angle value CSC, The stability window and noise/signal-to-noise ratio are clearly verified [24]. As for paacp, PPy/ANF/PVA and ionic CMCNa/PAA/Fe3+ systems, those unreported items are actually recorded as NR, which cannot be inferred from bulk conductivity or other device demonstrations [19,21,22]. Adhering to this reporting specification can at least avoid mistaking the conductivity at the material level for a fully validated chronic nerve interface.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Conductive hydrogel bioelectronics for chronic neuromodulation: From biomimetic design and bioactive interfaces to integrated neural platforms》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【NAM-enabled development and validation pathway · p0420】When we consider NAMs (new approach methodologies) in the development process of conductive hydrogel neural interface, we might as well organize them into a decision gate that passes in sequence, rather than scattered single detection. After a round of screening based on human cells, the candidate formula will enter the interface model at the tissue level, controlled toxicity and degradation test, and computer optimization. The evidence generated by these steps will eventually point to those questions that still need chronic in vivo verification to be answered [11,12].

【NAM-enabled development and validation pathway · p0425】In the door of material screening, neural cells and neural organs derived from human IPSC can be used to compare the effects of cell compatibility, maturity of neurons and glial cells, network activity, stiffness, conductivity, cross-linking density, residual chemicals and sterilization methods. The integration of organoid and bioelectronics has been able to achieve electrophysiological records across tissues or for several months [131,132]. Therefore, it is possible to screen at the functional level, and it is no longer just to watch the cell live or die.
